fields.label: Splat file
fields.description: Upload a Gaussian splat as .ply (standard 3DGS output, also compressed .ply) or .sog (PlayCanvas SOG, much smaller). Large .ply files load slowly – consider converting them to .sog first.

fields.label: Up direction in the file
fields.description: Most captures made with 3D Gaussian Splatting tools (COLMAP, Postshot, Nerfstudio, GaussForge) use -Y as up. Change this if the scene appears upside down or on its side.

fields.label: Fine-tune orientation
fields.description: Optional small corrections, in degrees, if the scene looks tilted. The preview above updates when you change a value.

fields.label: Alternative text
fields.description: Describe the scene for people using screen readers.

semantics.label: Hotspots
semantics.description: Numbered markers on the scene that learners click to see text, images, video or audio. Use the "Add hotspot" button under the preview above, then click the scene where it should go.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Shown when hovering over the hotspot and as the heading of its popup.

fields.label: Load the scene
fields.description: Splat files can be large. Choose "When the learner clicks" to show the poster image and a load button first.

fields.label: Auto-rotate
fields.description: Slowly rotate the scene until the learner turns it off.

fields.label: Allow fly mode (W, A, S, D)
fields.description: Learners can fly through the scene like in SuperSplat: W, A, S, D move, Q/E move down/up, drag looks around, Shift moves faster. Pressing a movement key switches to fly mode.

fields.label: Starting camera mode
fields.description: Orbit suits objects. Fly suits rooms and landscapes you move through.

fields.label: Background image
fields.description: Optional image shown behind the splat. Set the background colour's transparency to see it.

fields.label: Poster image
fields.description: Optional image shown before the scene has loaded, for example a screenshot of the scene.

fields.label: Aspect ratio
fields.description: Width to height, for example 16:9, 4:3 or 1:1.

fields.label: Maximum width
fields.description: Optional maximum width in CSS units, for example 800px or 50rem.

fields.label: Minimum height
fields.description: Optional minimum height in CSS units, for example 300px.

fields.label: Maximum height
fields.description: Optional maximum height in CSS units, for example 40rem.

fields.label: No splat found
fields.default: Could not load a Gaussian splat. Did someone forget to upload one?

fields.label: Load error
fields.default: The 3D scene could not be loaded.

fields.label: Unsupported file
fields.default: This file is not a supported Gaussian splat. Please use a .ply or .sog file.

fields.label: PLY without splat data
fields.default: This PLY file does not contain Gaussian splat data.

fields.label: WebGL 2 not available
fields.default: Your browser does not support WebGL 2, which is needed to display this 3D scene.

fields.label: Mouse wheel hint
fields.default: Click the scene or hold Ctrl to zoom with the mouse wheel

fields.label: Empty hotspot
fields.default: This hotspot has no content yet.

fields.label: Default label for the scene
fields.description: Used when no alternative text has been set.

fields.label: Interaction instructions
fields.description: Read out to screen reader users when the scene gets focus.
fields.default: Orbit mode: drag to rotate, right-drag or Shift-drag to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom, arrow keys rotate. Pressing W, A, S or D switches to fly mode: W, A, S, D and the arrow keys move, Q and E move down and up, drag to look around, scroll to move forwards or backwards. Hold Shift to move faster. Home resets the view.

fields.label: Fly mode button
fields.default: Switch to fly mode (W, A, S, D to move, drag to look around)

fields.label: Orbit mode button
fields.default: Switch to orbit mode (drag to rotate around the scene)

fields.label: Hotspot label (used when a hotspot has no title)
